advancements.guhs.quest.kaasmaan_bezocht: Set foot on the Cheese Moon
advancements.guhs.quest.raket_romp.title: A hull with ears
block.guhs.kaasmaankristal_erts.lore: Only in the craters of the Cheese Moon. Sparkles like a guh that spots a nibble.
block.guhs.lanceerplatform.lore: Build your own Cheese Rocket here, in four steps. Click it with the things on you; sneak-click: what is still needed.
block.guhs.maanvlaggetje.lore: Plant it on the Cheese Moon: one small step for a guh, one giant nibble for guhkind.
block.guhs.terugkeercapsule.lore: Click it and you're home in a jiffy. Pack your cheese moon crystals!
gui.guhs.kaasmaan.aankomst: Welcome to the Cheese Moon! It smells... very much of cheese here. Go on, jump: everything is lighter here.
gui.guhs.kaasmaan.kaasje.gekocht: Kaasje gives you: %s. "Safe travels, and don't forget to wave!"
gui.guhs.kaasmaan.kaasje.praat.0: Kaasje: "Hello earthling! Or... guhling? Mind the craters, that's where the prettiest crystals are."
gui.guhs.kaasmaan.kaasje.praat.1: Kaasje: "I've lived here a long time. The nibbles are free here, you just have to take a bite."
gui.guhs.kaasmaan.kaasje.praat.2: Kaasje: "Vahoeg, a visitor! Got cheese moon crystals for me? Then I've got souvenirs for you."
gui.guhs.kaasmaan.kaasje.ruil: Swapping: click with cheese moon crystals in your hand. %s = little moon flag, %s = cheese moon rock, %s = mini rocket. (Sneak-click: always the flag.)
gui.guhs.kaasmaan.terug: The capsule sets you down gently at home. See you next time, Cheese Moon!
gui.guhs.kaasmaan.vlag: You planted a flag on the Cheese Moon! One small step for a guh...
gui.guhs.raket.bemanning.nodig: %s astronaut guhs are ready, %s are needed. (Your own guhs, in an astronaut suit, close by.)
gui.guhs.raket.bemanning.uitleg: Bring %s of your own guhs in an astronaut suit to the pad and click it: then they climb in.
gui.guhs.raket.cmd.bemanning: Three astronaut guhs are ready for you.
gui.guhs.raket.cmd.spullen: All rocket things are in your bag.
gui.guhs.raket.cmd.stap: The pad now has %s steps done.
gui.guhs.raket.gelanceerd: Launch successful! Next stop: the Cheese Moon.
gui.guhs.raket.klaar_voor_lancering: The Cheese Rocket is ready! Click the pad: 5... 4... 3...
gui.guhs.raket.naar_maan: Click the pad and the rocket takes you to the Cheese Moon.
gui.guhs.raket.stap.klaar: %s is done! The rocket grows, njeg!
gui.guhs.raket.volgende: Next step: %s. Sneak-click the pad to see what's needed.
item.guhs.kaasmaankristal.lore: Astronaut Kaasje gladly swaps them for souvenirs.
scene.guhs.raket_lancering.klaar: All guhs aboard? Seatbelts on, ears down!
scene.guhs.raket_lancering.titel: The launch of the Cheese Rocket
scene.guhs.raket_lancering.weg: There she goes, straight to the Cheese Moon!
